predict.prompt: 16 ÷ 2 — what is the question really asking?

options.label: How many in each of 2 equal groups

predict.reveal: Division splits a total into equal groups. 16 shared into 2 groups gives 8 each. Subtracting instead would leave 14 — but 14 in each of 2 groups rebuilds 28, not 16.
